verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Agentic accounts and the Agentic Wallet let an AI agent hold USDC and spend it on x402 services, and buyers can pay from a CDP wallet. The docs do not show how the user funds or controls that wallet, beyond batch-settlement escrow with signed limits and refund or withdrawal rights. Advanced Trade x402 payments are still 'coming soon'. Missing for 10: documented balance visibility, user funding and top-up flow, owner controls such as spend caps and revocation on the agent wallet, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
